description: This file provides template implementations and utility classes for concurrent queue operations, including bulk push/pop, blocking pop with sleep policies, and queue consumer wrappers, within the ocudu::detail::queue_helper namespace.

classes.name: basic_queue_consumer
classes.description: A wrapper class providing try_pop, try_pop_bulk, and optionally pop_blocking methods for a concurrent queue.

classes.name: queue_sleep_crtp
classes.description: A CRTP base class adding blocking push/pop methods with sleep policy to derived queue classes.

methods.name: try_pop_bulk_generic
methods.description: Attempts to pop multiple elements from a queue in bulk.

methods.name: try_push_bulk_generic
methods.description: Attempts to push multiple elements into a queue in bulk.

methods.name: pop_blocking_generic
methods.description: Blocking pop operation with optional timeout, using sleep policy.
